questions.question: What shape does project_visual_tokens produce from tokens shaped (N, P, 32) with output_dim=64?
questions.explanation: The seeded affine bridge changes only the last feature width; batch and patch axes remain N and P.

questions.question: Which operation turns projected (N, P, D) tokens into one feature vector per example?
questions.explanation: mean_pool_tokens averages over the patch axis and returns (N,D), preserving one row per example.

questions.question: Why does cross_entropy_loss subtract a row maximum before exponentiating?
options: To force every class logit to zero
To avoid overflow while preserving the log-sum-exp difference
questions.explanation: Subtracting the maximum leaves the softmax ratios unchanged while keeping exponentials in a safe numerical range.

questions.question: Three same-grid feature layers each have width 32. What is deepstack_features' final width?
questions.explanation: DeepStack concatenates the last axis, so 32+32+32=96 while batch and patch dimensions stay unchanged.

questions.question: When does cross_modal_error_rate flag a pair?
options: Similarity is low regardless of confidence
Confidence is high and cosine similarity is below the similarity threshold
Confidence is low and similarity is high
questions.explanation: The gate is `(confidence > conf_threshold) & (similarity < sim_threshold)` after stable row normalization.

questions.question: What should happen when a target label equals the number of classifier columns?
options: It is rejected because valid IDs are 0 through C-1
questions.explanation: A class index equal to C is out of range; the local CE contract raises ValueError instead of silently wrapping it.
